summary: First full run. Backend: 27 pytest cases (auth, admin route protection, project CRUD, slug uniqueness, files 409/404/403 scoping, search, dropbox not-configured states, oauth callback redirect) - 25 pass, 2 fail (brute-force lockout ineffective behind ingress; /link and /thumb do Dropbox client() before scope check). Frontend: home hero/nav/typewriter/category row/coverflow (5 slides, Jasmin centered, prev/next/dots), worlds filter + clear, active card -> /p/jasmins-journey with 'No folder linked yet', search 'wba' + ENTER -> /search?q=wba with WBA + files-unavailable note, Projects bento + filter chips, Archive (5 rows), Studio, Contact, bell popover, help dialog, profile -> /admin/login, wrong pw error, login, Dropbox card 'App keys missing' + redirect URI, create/edit/delete TEST_ project via dialog, browse button disabled, session persists on reload, logout -> redirects to login, mobile 390 - all work. One mobile overflow issue on PageShell pages.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout ineffective: identifier = request.client.host which is the ingress pod IP (observed 10.79.128.66 and 10.79.128.69 alternating for same client). 6 bad attempts split 3/3 across two identifiers -> 6th attempt returned 401 not 429. Fix: use first IP from X-Forwarded-For (fallback client.host), or key lockout on email only.

minor.issue: await dbx.client(db) is called BEFORE _scoped(root, path), so a path outside the project folder returns 503 (not configured) / would make Dropbox client setup before rejecting. /files does scope check first correctly. Move _scoped() above client() in project_link and project_thumb.
Lockout window never truly resets: after 15 min count stays >=5, so a single further failure updates 'last' and re-locks immediately. Reset count when the window has expired.

backend FRONTEND_URL (adbd865d-...preview.emergentagent.com) differs from frontend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (all-is-good--31c91em5.preview.emergentagent.com). Dropbox redirect URI shown in admin and post-OAuth redirect use the adbd865d host, and CORS allow_origins only lists that host. Both hosts respond, but make sure the redirect URI registered in the Dropbox app matches the host users actually use.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow on mobile 390px: scrollWidth=429. Decorative blob 'absolute -top-40 right-[-10%] w-[620px]' extends past viewport. Fix: add overflow-x-clip (not overflow-hidden, which would break sticky nav) on the PageShell root, or clip the blob in its own overflow-hidden absolute container.

issues: Card title/subtitle overlays cover art that already contains baked-in title text (e.g. WBA card) - text competes visually; consider stronger bottom gradient.
Typewriter placeholder truncated ('All is good. Sear') at 390px - acceptable but could use smaller font size on mobile.

action_items: Fix login lockout identifier to use X-Forwarded-For client IP (or email-only key) so lockout works behind ingress; reset count after window expiry
In project_link and project_thumb, call _scoped(root, path) before dbx.client(db)
Fix mobile horizontal overflow from PageShell decorative blob (overflow-x-clip on root)
Align FRONTEND_URL with the actual public host used (affects Dropbox redirect URI, post-OAuth redirect and CORS)
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py/server.py: bcrypt $2b$ hash confirmed, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie set, CORS explicit origin with credentials - OK. seed() inserts admin only if missing and never updates password - OK.
Lockout keyed on proxy IP (see backend critical).
project_search does not validate category/q beyond length - fine; global_search swallows per-project Dropbox errors - OK.
Project delete uses native window.confirm instead of a shadcn AlertDialog - inconsistent with design system.
Admin list rows don't show subtitle, so edit success is only visible via toast/API.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created TEST_ projects (via API and UI) and deleted them by id; verified 0 TEST_ projects remain. Removed TEST_ lockout login_attempts rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host (all-is-good--31c91em5). Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_cooked_world_api.py (pytest.ini uses xdist). Expected failures until fixed: test_bruteforce_lockout, test_scope_check (link/thumb ordering). Dropbox keys not configured - real browsing untested. Delete uses window.confirm (handle page dialog in Playwright).
rca of the issue: Lockout: request.client.host behind K8s ingress = ingress pod IP; multiple ingress pods => attempts counted under different identifiers. Scope ordering: project_link/project_thumb await dbx.client() before _scoped(); client() raises 503 when keys missing, masking the 403.
